svg.title: AWS 3-Tier Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: A structural diagram showing the AWS 3-tier architecture with VPC, public and private subnets, ALB, frontend EC2 Auto Scaling, backend EC2 Auto Scaling, and RDS MySQL across two availability zones.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do users connect to the AWS 3-tier app through the internet?')
sendPrompt('What does the Application Load Balancer do in AWS?')
sendPrompt('What runs on the frontend EC2 instances?')
sendPrompt('Why are frontend instances in two availability zones?')
sendPrompt('What runs on the backend EC2 tier in AWS?')
sendPrompt('Why is the backend EC2 in a private subnet with no public IP?')

svg.text: DB subnets · isolated · no internet access

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does RDS MySQL work in a private subnet?')
sendPrompt('What is RDS Multi-AZ standby and how does failover work?')

svg.text: 🔒 sg-alb → sg-frontend → sg-backend → sg-rds · least privilege security groups
